title: I Hijacked This Streamer's Chess Tournament
summary: After trading wins 4-4 with streamer H1 Chess on stream, he joins H1's 30-second Hyperbullet arena (30 minutes) at 1 AM to try to beat him; plays many 30s games vs 1500-2500 players (e.g. Vinuka_Wijerathna 2521), loses some he shouldn't, and the tournament ends with his last game aborted.
rules: Normal chess, 30-second hyperbullet (0:20 clocks seen), arena pairing (berserk/streaks per chess.com arena).

opponent.name: H1 Chess (streamer) and arena opponents (e.g. Vinuka_Wijerathna 2521)
opponent.avatar_description: Thumbnail: cartoon of smiling streamer in red hoodie with 'I won't LOSE' text; chess.com default avatars in game.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green board, hyperbullet clocks; stream overlay with webcam and chessreps logo.

current_impl_issues: Gauntlet of tournament rounds vs bots is an acceptable stand-in; could use a 30-second clock to be faithful. No variant.
evidence: Transcript 0:01-1:39 stream clips with H1 chess, 'perfectly equal at four wins each... joining his 30 second Hyperbullet tournament... The arena is 30 minutes'; 'we start with 1500'; 'the game is aborted. Okay, the tournament is over'.
